info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking Operational Services Reward By Reward Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Operational Services Reward Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about specific rewards using a unique reward identifier. This API is essential for financial institutions and service providers looking to manage and present rewards to their customers effectively. Typical use cases involve fetching reward details for customer inquiries, promotional campaigns, or reward program management. By integrating this API, developers can enhance user engagement through tailored reward offerings and insights.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific reward by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific reward identified by its unique ID. This can include information such as the reward name, description, eligibility, and other relevant details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the rewards for the specified operational service. It expects a JSON format with specific parameters that identify the service and any other relevant information. Ensure that you follow the schema structure outlined in the defined schema.
